name: Beastmaster
description:
Whenever you roll Lore to recall information about animals, +2d.

Additionally, you may attempt to use any animal that can bear your weight as a mount. If the animal is unwilling, roll Lore vs Strength against it. If you or your allies have harmed the animal within the past day, your roll is ill-favored and the animal’s roll is favored. On a win, it becomes willing to bear you.

Describe how you tame it.
